Basal cell carcinoma of the vulva is rare and similar to that at other skin sites. Please refer to the WHO classification of skin tumours for further details [[Elder DE, Massi D, Scolyer RA, et al., editors. WHO classification of skin tumours. Lyon (France): International Agency for Research on Cancer; 2018. (WHO classification of tumours series, 4th ed.; vol. 11). https://publications.iarc.fr/560.]].

ICD-O coding

8090/3 Basal cell carcinoma NOS
